description: Guide complet de l'escalade de privilèges sous Linux
contenu:
# Privilege Escalation Linux

## 1. Information Gathering
uname -a
id
sudo -l
cat /etc/sudoers
find / -perm -4000 -ls 2>/dev/null

## 2. SUID Binaries
find / -type f -perm -u=s 2>/dev/null
strings /usr/bin/something
strace -e trace=execve /usr/bin/something

## 3. Kernel Exploits
uname -r
cat /proc/version

## 4. Sudo Exploitation
sudo -l
sudo -u user command

## 5. NOPASSWD Exploitation
grep -r NOPASSWD /etc/sudoers

## 6. Path Exploitation
echo $PATH
ls -la /usr/local/bin

## 7. Weak File Permissions
find / -type f -perm 0777 2>/dev/null
find / -type d -perm 0777 2>/dev/null

## 8. Cron Jobs
cat /etc/crontab
ls -la /etc/cron.d/
ls -la /etc/cron.daily/

contenu: # Web Penetration Testing ## OWASP Top 10 Reconnaissance ### 1. Reconnaissance whois domain.com nmap -sV -sC domain.com whatweb domain.com google dorking: site:domain.com ### 2. SQL Injection sqlmap -u "http://site.com/page?id=1" --dbs sqlmap -u "http://site.com/page?id=1" --dump ' OR '1'='1 admin' OR '1'='1' -- ### 4. XSS Testing ### 5. CSRF Testing ### 6. Directory Enumeration dirbuster gobuster dir -u http://site.com -w wordlist.txt ffuf -u http://site.com/FUZZ -w wordlist.txt ### 7. Parameter Fuzzing burpsuite intruder sqlmap -u "http://site.com/page?id=1" -p id ### 8. Authentication Bypass default credentials by passing login token manipulation

# Bash Scripting

## Variables
VAR="value"
echo $VAR
readonly VAR
unset VAR

## Paramètres
$0 - nom du script
$1, $2, etc - arguments
$# - nombre d'arguments
$@ - tous les arguments
$? - code de retour

## Boucles For
for i in {1..10}; do echo $i; done
for file in *.txt; do cat $file; done
for ((i=0; i<10; i++)); do echo $i; done

## Boucles While
while [ condition ]; do command; done
while read line; do echo $line; done < file.txt

## Conditions
if [ $var -eq 5 ]; then
  echo "Equal"
fi

[ $a -lt $b ] - moins que
[ $a -gt $b ] - plus que
[ $a -eq $b ] - égal
[ $a -ne $b ] - différent
[ -f file ] - fichier existe
[ -d dir ] - répertoire existe

## Fonctions
function_name() {
  echo "Hello"
  return 0
}

function my_func() {
  local var="local value"
  return $1
}

## Substitution de Commande
result=$(command)
result=`command`

## Pipes et Redirections
command1 | command2
command > file
command >> file
command < file
command 2>&1

description: Techniques d'escalade de privilèges sous Windows
contenu:
# Windows Privilege Escalation

## Information Gathering
whoami
whoami /priv
whoami /groups
systeminfo
netsh wlan show profile
ipconfig /all
route print

## Unquoted Service Paths
wmic service list brief
wmic service list brief | findstr "Running"
Get-WmiObject win32_service | Select-Object Name,PathName | Where-Object {$_.PathName -notlike '"*'}

## Weak Folder Permissions
icacls C:\Program Files\*

## Registry Modification
reg query HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services
reg add HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Run /v malware /d C:\path\malware.exe

## UAC Bypass
BypassUAC.exe
WINDIR% \System32\wusa.exe /extract:C:\temp /quiet

## Token Impersonation
Incognito.exe list_tokens -u
incognito.exe delegate_tokens

## Scheduled Tasks
tasklist /V
tasksched.msc
schtasks /query /fo LIST /v

## DLL Hijacking
Process Monitor (procmon.exe)
Find DLL's in user writable directories

## Kernel Exploits
wmic os get version
wmic os get buildnumber

# Network Reconnaissance

## Ping Sweep
for i in {1..254}; do ping -c 1 192.168.1.$i | grep "bytes from" & done
nmap -sn 192.168.1.0/24

## DNS Enumeration
nslookup domain.com
nslookup -query=MX domain.com
nslookup -query=NS domain.com
dig domain.com
dig domain.com ANY
dig domain.com @ns.domain.com

## Zone Transfer
nslookup -ls -d domain.com ns.domain.com
dig domain.com @ns.domain.com AXFR
dig domain.com +long +noall +answer

## Whois
whois domain.com
whois IP

## Port Scanning
nmap -p- target
nmap -sT target
nmap -sS target
nmap -sU target
nmap -sV target

## Service Detection
bannergrabing
netcat -v target port
telnet target port

## Traceroute
traceroute domain.com
tracert domain.com (Windows)
mtr domain.com

## Reverse DNS Lookup
nslookup IP
dig -x IP

## Network Mapping
nmap -A target
nmap -O target
nmap --script discovery target
